description: ALTER COLUMN ... SET DATA TYPE semantics: only the widening retypes are permitted (VARCHAR length growth, NUMBER precision moving either way at UNCHANGED scale, synonymous restatements like TIMESTAMP_NTZ->TIMESTAMP and INTEGER->BIGINT) - every cross-family change (to VARCHAR, INTEGER, DATE, BOOLEAN), VARCHAR shrink (with its own live sentence naming both parameterized types) and NUMBER scale change is refused 'cannot change column'; missing columns/tables error, IF EXISTS forgives the table, retypes preserve comments, primary keys and data, and compose with other ALTER operations. Converted 1:1 from features/AlterColumnTest (now retired).

error.messageContains: cannot change column BODY from type VARCHAR(1000) to VARCHAR(100)

steps.sql: ALTER TABLE notes ALTER COLUMN body SET DATA TYPE VARCHAR(100)

error.messageContains: because reducing the byte-length of a varchar is not supported.
